## Professional Summary

Juan is an aerospace systems engineer and technical leader specializing in digital twins, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), and data-driven decision-making. His work at Blue Origin connects system architecture and engineering models to support advanced space programs. He combines a mechanical engineering background with graduate training in business analytics.
